Product Features

  • HIGH-GLOSS TABLE TOP: High-quality, glossy surface with protective film against scratches.
  • INNOVATIVE GLASS DESIGN: Seamless integration of glass into the tabletop for a modern look.
  • INTEGRATED DRAWER: Extra storage space for magazines, remote controls and more.
  • ROBUST CONSTRUCTION: High-quality materials for durability and stability.
  • EASY INSTALLATION: Detailed instructions and protective film for hassle-free installation.
  • SHOCKPROOF GLASS: Safe and impact-resistant glass top for everyday use.
  • MODERN DESIGN: Elegant combination of white and glass for different interior styles.
  • Compared with the traditional form of remote-controlled LED light strips, these LED lights use a new control method. You can scan the QR code in the manual, download the APP, and realize a smart remote control through the APP, which effectively avoids the loss or malfunction of the remote control lose this situation
  • Compared with the traditional wired remote control, this LED light can be realized through the mobile phone's smart Bluetooth remote control, and has a memory function as long as it is connected once, and then open the Bluetooth to achieve automatic connection! The color, brightness and color temperature of the LED light can be selected according to the environment and time of day. This LED bulb can be timed via a mobile phone APP
